records.name: React UScrollPanel
records.purpose: Wrap native scrolling content with proportional draggable custom scrollbar thumbs and an imperative refresh/scroll API.
records.surface: UScrollPanel is React.forwardRef<UScrollPanelHandle, UScrollPanelProps>. UScrollPanelProps exposes step (default 5), className and children. UScrollPanelHandle exposes refresh:() => void and scrollTop:(value:number) => void through useImperativeHandle; scrollTop clamps to the native scrollable height and zero. Private moveBar computes scroll ratios, sizes thumbs with a minimum 10 percent and uses requestAnimationFrame to set positions; ratios >=1 hide the bar. Scroll, resize and mouseenter update bars. Mouse dragging installs document listeners and updates native scroll position using delta/ratio; cleanup removes listeners, cancels a frame and clears the timer.
